# AtroUI

> Dark-first React / Next.js component catalog. Install with the shadcn CLI and own the source in your repo.
> Site: https://www.atroui.com
> Registry: https://www.atroui.com/r/{name}.json
> Directory: listed as `@atroui` in https://ui.shadcn.com/r/registries.json
> Repo: https://github.com/atroui/atroui

## Install

```bash
npx shadcn@latest init
npx shadcn@latest add @atroui/home-hero
```

`@atroui` is in the official shadcn registry directory. No manual `registry add` URL step.
